## Summary
- Add `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE` and a deterministic `agent-self-merge.yml` workflow/CLI.
- Route `agent-self-approve -> approved` to self-merge only when self-merge is enabled, while preserving disabled stop behavior and `REQUEST_CHANGES -> fix-pr`.
- Verify open non-draft PRs, current-head Sepo self-approval, no blocking requested changes, check/mergeability state, and default-branch base safety before merging or enabling auto-merge.
- Add marker-upserted self-merge statuses, docs, and focused regression tests.

## Verification
- `npm run build`
- `node --test dist/__tests__/self-merge.test.js dist/__tests__/resolve-self-merge-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/handoff.test.js dist/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/orchestrator-preflight-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/sub-orchestration.test.js dist/__tests__/post-response-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #200

## Rubrics Review

| Total Score | Verdict | Rubrics Scored |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 95 | PARTIAL | 12 |

| Dimension | Rubric | Result | Score | Evidence |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| coding_workflow / generic | Validate delegated route authorization | pass | 8/8 | `agent-self-merge` is added to the initial `/orchestrate` delegated route capability set only when both self-approval and self-merge are enabled, with tests for the authorization stop path. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Reuse existing code | pass | 8/8 | The PR keeps workflow glue thin and puts merge preflight in typed modules/CLIs: `.agent/src/self-merge.ts`, `.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-merge.ts`, and GitHub helpers in `.agent/src/github.ts`. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Prefer explicit structured inputs | pass | 7/7 | The new workflow uses explicit `pr_number`, orchestration, round, requester, and session inputs instead of overloading a string command. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Make user-facing automation idempotent | pass | 7/7 | Self-merge statuses use `SELF_MERGE_STATUS_MARKER` and `upsertPrCommentByMarker`, so reruns update the existing trusted marker comment instead of creating repeated statuses. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Comment on accepted workflow stops | pass | 6/6 | Non-merge outcomes such as blocked/waiting self-merge write a visible status; stacked bases return `waiting` with “waiting on the base PR” rather than silently stopping. |
| communication / generic | Keep status comments compact | pass | 6/6 | `formatSelfMergeBody` uses a short status/conclusion table plus a single reason and run link. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Make surgical changes | pass | 8/8 | Changes are scoped to the requested self-merge route, orchestration handoff, docs, and focused tests; no broad unrelated refactor is evident. |
| coding_style / generic | Prefer simple implementations | pass | 7/7 | The resolver is deterministic and linear: gate, PR state, draft, current-head approval, base branch, requested changes, checks, then merge/auto-merge decision. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Use default merge flow | pass | 7/7 | GitHub merge helpers use `gh pr merge --merge` and `--merge --auto`, not squash. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Keep docs in sync | pass | 7/7 | Docs were updated in actions, supported workflows, configuration, request lifecycle, orchestrator details, and key concepts. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Surface stateful failures | pass | 7/7 | Merge and auto-merge failures become `failed` conclusions with surfaced reasons, and status-comment upsert failures set a nonzero exit code. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Read docs and linked context first | partial | 4/6 | The implementation follows the requested design, but the requested stack refresh was not completed: PR #202 is based on #186 head `9a515285...`; #186 is still based on `4062890...`, while #184 head is now `e5fc865...`. |

## Notes

- The implementation strongly satisfies the self-merge design rubrics: separate opt-in gate, deterministic resolver, current-head self-approval validation, requested-changes/check/base safeguards, immediate merge vs auto-merge behavior, idempotent visible statuses, and focused regression coverage.
- The only rubric-specific gap is stack hygiene from the linked context: refresh #186 onto the current #184 head, then rebase/refresh #202 if needed.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** `read-docs-first` / linked context was only partially honored. The request explicitly said #186 should first be refreshed onto the latest #184 head before adding this stacked PR. Live PR metadata shows #202 is stacked on #186, but #186’s base OID is `406289094cf4ddef7a8c4b3dea98b48dc2f756ea` while #184’s current head is `e5fc865406f35cd15c713bb346e1149b5b9e4263`.

## Final Rubric Verdict
